| MODEL-002 | `an_extent_the_format_forbids_never_steers_reach` | An extent on a kind the body format forbids one on must not steer reach. `snapshot.rs` refuses an `extent_host` on an aggregate, volume, encryption layer or multipath node, but `assemble` applies no such rule, so an in-process caller — which is what the planner and the capability engine are — can hold a snapshot that could never round-trip.
